ios.desc:
Caddie is your personal golf performance coach in your pocket — always ready to listen, reflect, and help you play with more clarity.

Whether you’re frustrated after a round or curious how to improve your next one, Caddie responds like a real caddie or coach would: calmly, concisely, and with one small, actionable tweak you can try right away.

Vent, reflect, and reset after tough rounds

Get on-course tweaks for your aim, tempo, or mindset

Keep your entire chat history saved privately on your device

No lessons. No swing overhauls. Just smarter, calmer golf

Built by golfers, for golfers — because the toughest part of the game isn’t your swing, it’s your head.

Privacy Policy: https://caddie-ai.co/privacy
Terms: https://caddie-ai.co/terms

show_hn.title: Show HN: Caddie AI – an AI caddie/therapist you can vent to after a bad round

quotes.text:
Hey HN

I built Caddie AI, a simple AI chat app for golfers to vent, reflect, and get calm feedback after a frustrating round.

It’s not a swing analyzer or stat tracker — it’s more like a friendly caddie who listens, reframes your thinking, and gives one small actionable tip (or just lets you blow off steam).

The chat is stored locally on device, no signups or data collection, and the backend just calls OpenAI’s Responses API with a golf-specific prompt.

Tech: UIKit + Laravel backend + OpenAI API

Website → https://caddie-ai.co

Would love feedback on:
– whether the tone feels natural (not repetitive)
– ideas to make it more habit-forming (right now it’s one endless chat)
– pricing expectations (currently $2.99/month on the App Store) 3 free messages a day on freemium

Thanks for checking it out!
